name: explora Atacama
positioning: All-inclusive desert lodge near San Pedro de Atacama, designed by Chilean architect Jose Cruz Ovalle, with guided Explorations, four interconnected pools, a spa, an onsite observatory and its own stables
best_for: Active travelers who want guided small-group hiking, biking and horseback Explorations included in the stay
Stargazers who want an onsite observatory
Couples who want hot springs, a spa and pools between desert outings

facts.text: Explora Atacama sits on a 42-acre (17-hectare) desert estate near San Pedro de Atacama.
The lodge sits on the Ayllu de Larache, surrounded by the sand dunes and high-elevation parklands of San Pedro de Atacama.
The lodge was designed by Chilean architect Jose Cruz Ovalle.
Soaring spaces, sweeping views and locally sourced furnishings define the grounds and interiors.
One of the pools is warmed to 77 to 82 degrees Fahrenheit (25 to 28 degrees Celsius).
Explora's private Puritama Conservation Reserve lies deep in an Andean canyon and is a river oasis and sanctuary for endangered wildlife.
Guides are trained at Explora's own School of Guides and are fluent in Spanish and English.
Each evening an Explora guide meets with guests to tailor the next day's Explorations to their preferences.
Explorations include hiking the Cordillera de la Sal with views to the Valley of the Moon.
The stay includes breakfast, lunch and dinner, all beverages, wine and an open bar.
National park entrance fees and round-trip airport transfers are included with the stay.
The hotel's horses have been bred specifically for the region.

highlights.text: Guests can soak in natural hot springs located exclusively in Explora's Puritama Conservation Reserve.
The lodge has its own onsite observatory and horseback riding stables.
Four interconnected pools, surrounded by tall pampas grass and Atacama flora, each offer a different experience.
The spa is in a traditional adobe house, with treatments, a sauna, steam baths and outdoor hot tubs.
Explorations are limited to groups of no more than eight guests.

considerations.text: Getting there means a 2-hour connecting flight from Santiago to Calama.
Because of the remote location, Wi-Fi in rooms and common areas may vary in reliability.
In winter, temperatures at the lodge range from minus 10 degrees Celsius (14 Fahrenheit) at night to 20 degrees Celsius (68 Fahrenheit) in the daytime.
